source: College admission fee structure sheets A.Y. 2026-2027 (UG P.N.G., UG Grantable, UG Professional, PG M.A./M.Com, PG M.Sc., Ph.D.) plus FeesStruc_AZAMCAMPUS summary sheet which also provides OTHER STATE, SAARC and NRI/PIO/Foreigners totals for UG classes. All line-item amounts are in rupees; the import converts them to paise.

summaryTotals.note: Total admission fee amounts from the FeesStruc_AZAMCAMPUS summary sheet for non-PAYING categories. No line-item breakdown is available from the college for these categories — only the totals are on the summary sheet. The import stores these as single-row FeeStructure records with no heads array.
